clare: quick heads-up: canary sign failing for base-minimal. cosign shows AccessDenied for kms:Sign from ephemeral builders. planning 18:30 PT hotfix window to either patch trust or use ephemeral key. who can own?
omar: I can own. prefer ephemeral key to avoid touching prod policy. will create asymmetric ECDSA key and tag ephemeral:true with TTL=12h.
sec-bot: Record any RBAC/key change in SEC-9123. CloudTrail must capture Sign events and push to s3://redwood-audit/images/signs/.
clare: checklist for 18:30: 1) open SEC-9123, 2) create key, 3) grant kms:Sign + kms:GetPublicKey to role/ci-ephemeral, 4) update CI COSIGN_KEY_URI, 5) run smoke build+sign, 6) cosign verify --key ksm://... image:sha256:..., 7) upload public key to s3://redwood-provenance/keys/, 8) disable key and revert.
omar: will do steps 2-4, ping when CI env updated. I'll also upload pubkey and add manifest field provenance.signatures[0].keyId.
oncall: oncall standing by. if verify fails open #release-war-room immediately. runbook: https://redwood.atlassian.net/wiki/spaces/ops/pages/IMG-HOTPATCH-RB.
clare: vuln note: scanner flagged CVE-2026-3333 (libssl) in a sidecar. block cutover until Dockerfile pin PR merges and scan passes.
sec-bot: If ephemeral key used, require post-action audit: list last 10 Sign events for key id and attach to SEC-9123. If escape hatch used >1h, schedule 72h postmortem.
omar: CI env updated, kicking smoke build now. will post verify result in thread. :construction:
